sources.summary: Kim Kardashian has opened the London flagship branch of her apparel brand SKIMS, featuring voluptuous interiors by New York studio Rafael de Cárdenas. The store is characterised by the fleshy tones that have become synonymous with SKIMS, the minimalist shapewear and clothing brand launched by Kardashian and SKIMS CEO Jens Grede in 2019.
